nights.title: Marco Mengoni - Residency Allo Sbagliato
nights.name: Marco Mengoni
nights.extract: Marco Mengoni is an Italian singer-songwriter who rose to fame in 2009 after winning the third season of the Italian talent show X Factor. Since then he has sold over 2.8 million records in Italy, peaking the Italian albums chart seven consecutive times and entering the Top 10 Italian Singles Chart fifteen times. He won the Sanremo Music Festival in 2013 and again in 2023, therefore representing Italy in the Eurovision Song Contest in both years.

en.who: Marco Mengoni is an Italian singer-songwriter. Since 2009 he has sold over 2.8 million records in Italy and has reached the top of the Italian albums chart seven consecutive times.
facts: Marco Mengoni is an Italian singer-songwriter who rose to fame in 2009 after winning the third season of the Italian talent show X Factor.

de.who: Marco Mengoni ist ein italienischer Singer-Songwriter. Seit 2009 hat er in Italien über 2,8 Millionen Tonträger verkauft und erreichte sieben Mal in Folge die höchste Position der italienischen Albumcharts.
facts: Marco Mengoni ist ein italienischer Singer-Songwriter, der 2009 nach dem Sieg in der dritten Staffel der italienischen Castingshow X Factor bekannt wurde.
Er gewann das Festival von Sanremo 2013 und erneut 2023 und vertrat Italien dadurch in beiden Jahren beim Eurovision Song Contest.

tr.who: Marco Mengoni, İtalyan bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. 2009'dan beri İtalya'da 2,8 milyondan fazla kayıt sattı ve İtalyan albüm listesinin en üst sıralarına yedi kez üst üste ulaştı.
facts: Marco Mengoni, İtalya'daki X Factor yarışmasının üçüncü sezonunu kazanmasının ardından 2009'da ünlenen bir İtalyan şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır.
Sanremo Müzik Festivali'ni 2013 ve 2023'te kazandı; bu nedenle her iki yılda da İtalya'yı Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda temsil etti.

nights.title: Muse - The Wow! Signal Europa Tour
nights.name: Muse
nights.extract: Muse are an English rock band from Teignmouth, Devon, formed in 1994. The band consists of Matt Bellamy, Chris Wolstenholme, and Dominic Howard.

en.who: Muse is an English rock band from Teignmouth, Devon. It was formed in 1994 and is made up of three members.
